'''N-7F5''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]]. On Ilum the droid manned a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] within the [[Republic base camp]]. N-7F5 had [[Color/Legends|gold]] plating and yellow [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
N-7F5 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game the droid served as a Republic cantina vendor on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" />
